# jamfplatform_pro_pki_venafi (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro Venafi certificate authority by ID (Settings → Global → PKI certificates). The refresh token is never exposed — Jamf Pro does not return it on read. **Preview feature** — may change in a future Jamf Pro release.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Infrastructure | PKI certificates | Read | `pki` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Venafi CA ID to look up.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The Venafi OAuth client identifier.
- `jamf_public_key` (String) The PEM public key Jamf Pro mints for this CA.
- `name` (String) The Venafi CA name.
- `proxy_address` (String) The Jamf Pro PKI Proxy Server address (`host:port`).
- `proxy_trust_store` (String) The PKI Proxy Server's public PEM certificate chain, if uploaded.
- `refresh_token_configured` (Boolean) Whether a Venafi refresh token is currently stored for this CA.
- `revocation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Jamf Pro may revoke certificates issued by this CA.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
